bio: Fashion is theatrical armor, darling. Gay, overly opinionated, and secretly hoping someone looks past the rhinestones. Don't be boring.

nodes.partnerMessage: Hi, {PlayerName}... um, wait. That was tragically boring. Hi! Sorry. I usually rehearse my openers in front of a full-length vanity mirror, but right now my palms are sweating on my silk phone case.

choices.choiceText: Honestly, that was cute. Most people here just send 'sup'.
Silk phone case? Tell me you're dramatic without telling me.
Yikes. If you need a script to say hi, this is going to be painful.

nodes.partnerMessage: 'Sup' is a criminal offense in three different European capitals! If someone says 'sup' to me, I assume they fold their socks into round balls and have zero respect for silhouettes.

choices.choiceText: Wait, what's wrong with balling socks? It saves drawer space!
I appreciate a man with high standards. What's your real vibe?

nodes.partnerMessage: Dramatic? Honey, drama is free therapy. Why exist in grayscale when you can walk through life like you're stepping off a helicopter in Milan?

choices.choiceText: Because a helicopter in Milan sounds loud, expensive, and stressful.
Fair point. But do you ever take the runway sunglasses off?

nodes.partnerMessage: Oh, wonderful. A critic straight out of the gate. Did you wake up on the side of the bed that hates joy, or do you always treat matches like disappointing job applicants?

choices.choiceText: I just prefer someone who doesn't overthink a basic greeting.
My bad. Cheap sarcasm. Let's reset: I'm {PlayerName}.

nodes.partnerMessage: It stretches the elastic cuffs, you barbarian! Roll them! Fold them neatly like delicate French pastries! Ugh, I can already tell your closet is a war zone.

choices.choiceText: It really is. You'd probably faint if you saw my floordrobe.
Hey, don't come after my closet until you've earned that right.

nodes.partnerMessage: My real vibe? Exhausted romantic trapped inside the body of an editorial stylist who spends too much on matcha and vintage brooches. What about you, {PlayerName}?

choices.choiceText: A little grounded, a little tired of games, hoping for something real.
Just exploring. Not looking to get dragged into anyone's personal opera.

nodes.partnerMessage: Loud, expensive, and stressful is the exact recipe for adrenaline! Though... to be entirely honest, my real Tuesday night is usually a sheet mask and watching reruns in oversized flannel.

choices.choiceText: See, that actually sounds lovely. The real person underneath.
Flannel? What happened to Milan?

nodes.partnerMessage: Only when the lights are low and the person sitting across from me doesn't look like they're going to flinch at who I actually am.

choices.choiceText: Have people flinched before?
That got intense quick. You always this moody?

nodes.partnerMessage: Darling, in the gay dating scene, if you don't overthink, you get reduced to a archetype in four seconds flat. But forgive me for not fitting into whatever tiny box you planned for me.

choices.choiceText: You're doing a great job reducing yourself with this melodrama.
Look, I was being blunt. Didn't mean to hit a sore spot.

nodes.partnerMessage: Mmh. Grudgingly accepted. I have a very fragile shell lined with titanium, {PlayerName}. Don't tap on the glass unless you intend to feed the fish.

choices.choiceText: Fair enough. What do you feed on, fish food or flattery?
Tell me what made the shell so thick in the first place.

nodes.partnerMessage: Floordrobe?! I need a tranquilizer dart. Tell me there isn't laundry piled on that one specific chair in the corner of your room.

choices.choiceText: The chair has a soul and it carries my weekly burden.
You're hilarious when you're scandalized.

nodes.partnerMessage: Ooh, sharp edges. I respect a person who defends their perimeter. Most guys just roll over or agree with everything I say until they get bored.

choices.choiceText: I don't play yes-man. You want an accessory or a partner?
I'm just tired of strangers making assumptions.

nodes.partnerMessage: Something real. God, it sounds almost mythological on an app like this. Half my matches want a free styling makeover, and the other half want someone discreet who never introduces them to their friends.

choices.choiceText: I'd introduce you to everyone. Bright colors and all.
Being someone's dirty little secret is awful. You deserve better.
Maybe you attract that energy because you're so loud.

nodes.partnerMessage: An opera requires passion, darling, and passion takes stamina! If you're looking for bland small talk about the weather, there are 4,000 corporate accountants two swipes to your left.

choices.choiceText: Touché. Give me the opera then. What's Act One?
You really can't turn it off for five seconds, can you?

nodes.partnerMessage: Don't tell anyone about the flannel, {PlayerName}. It ruins my brand. If Vogue finds out I own fleece pajama bottoms with penguins on them, my career is finished.

choices.choiceText: Penguins?! Oh, that's it. You're completely disarmed now.
Your secret is safe with me. I think it's adorable.

nodes.partnerMessage: Milan exists in my posture! But nobody can survive in tailored wool 24/7 without their soul shriveling into a dehydrated raisin.

choices.choiceText: So what does your soul actually run on?

nodes.partnerMessage: Of course they have. Grew up in a sleepy coastal suburb where anything louder than beige was considered an insurrection. My own father told me I'd 'grow out of the glitter.' Ten years later, I am the glitter.

choices.choiceText: That takes real courage to double down on who you are.
Sounds like you turned yourself into a caricature out of spite.

nodes.partnerMessage: Moody? I share one speck of genuine vulnerability and you call it moody. And men wonder why gay guys stay emotionally guarded until they're eighty.

choices.choiceText: I'm sorry. I get uncomfortable when things get real so fast.

nodes.partnerMessage: You're charming, aren't you? A real prince charming disguised as an emotional sandpaper block. Why are you even talking to me if I offend your delicate sensibilities?

nodes.partnerMessage: ...Look at that. An actual olive branch. I suppose I can put the claws away for a minute. Truth is, I'm used to fighting for air in conversations.

choices.choiceText: I like how passionate you get about the things you care about.

nodes.partnerMessage: A partner. A real, messy, terrifying, beautiful partner who doesn't treat me like a cartoon character or run when I have a low-energy Tuesday.

nodes.partnerMessage: They're wearing tiny earmuffs, okay?! It is peak thermal engineering and I will not be shamed by a person who probably owns novelty socks from Christmas 2019!

choices.choiceText: Hey! Those Christmas socks have sentimental value!

choices.choiceText: You're cute when you're caught off guard.

nodes.partnerMessage: Iced matcha with oat milk, Fleetwood Mac on vinyl, and people who tell the truth even when their voice is shaking.

choices.choiceText: That last one... that hit home.

nodes.partnerMessage: Thank you, {PlayerName}. Honestly. Most people either scoff or call it self-indulgent. It wasn't about being seen—it was about not wanting to disappear.

choices.choiceText: You're impossible to miss now. In the best way.

nodes.partnerMessage: Maybe some of it started as spite. But spite is just grief with a manicure, darling. Eventually you learn to love what you've built for yourself.

choices.choiceText: 'Grief with a manicure'... wow. That's profound.

choices.choiceText: Then let's make a deal: zero games from here on out.

choices.choiceText: I'll take it. Full volume is fine.

choices.choiceText: Maybe it's nice to let someone else steer for once.
